name: Scenario AT: Catering Inquiry
comments: Triggered by a Freshchat conversation.created webhook. Keyword filter detects catering and events terms (catering, party, event, private dining, group booking, reservation). Claude extracts event date, party size, occasion, and dietary needs from the message. Creates a HubSpot deal tagged Catering-Inquiry. Sends a detailed inquiry summary to the restaurant admin via Resend. Generates an AI follow-up email requesting catering menu/pricing details and sends via Resend. Error route sends an internal alert. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex filter passes catering and events keywords. Register Make webhook URL in Freshchat Admin > Settings > Webhooks > Conversation Created.
Claude extracts structured catering inquiry details from the first Freshchat message. Temperature 0.1 for deterministic extraction.

notes.label: Module 1 — Freshchat Webhook + Catering Filter
notes.note: Fires on conversation.created. Case-insensitive regex: catering|party|event|private dining|group booking|reservation.

notes.label: Modules 2–3 — Claude: Extract Event Details
notes.note: Claude extracts event_date, party_size, occasion, dietary_needs, budget_per_head, preferred_time, venue. ParseJSON (module 3) structures the result.

notes.label: Module 4 — HubSpot Deal: Catering-Inquiry
notes.note: Deal name format: Catering-Inquiry — <occasion> — <customer> (<date>). deal_type=Catering-Inquiry. All extracted fields stored in description.

notes.label: Module 5 — Resend: Admin Inquiry Summary
notes.note: Purple-header HTML summary email to brian@cwiai.net. Full event details table with HubSpot deal ID and Freshchat conversation ID.

notes.label: Modules 6–7 — AI Follow-up Email to Customer
notes.note: Claude (module 6) writes a warm 4-6 sentence follow-up promising a menu/pricing proposal within 24 hours. Sent via Resend (module 7) from RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT with an event details summary table.

notes.label: Module 8 — Freshchat Acknowledgement
notes.note: Posts a hardcoded Freshchat acknowledgement confirming the inquiry was received and the email was sent. Gives the customer expectations for next steps.
